blocks.text: Birlik va ko'plik: shakl va ma'no doim mos kelmaydi

Ko'plik yasalishi, noto'g'ri ko'plik (men, children) va trousers, glasses kabi so'zlarning asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 66-dars). Bu darsda — qiyin holatlar, ya'ni otning **shakli** bilan fe'lning **soni** bir-biriga mos kelmaydigan joylar: `-s` bilan tugaydigan, lekin birlik bo'lgan otlar (**news**, **maths**); doim ko'plikdagi otlar (**clothes**, **stairs**); birlik ham, ko'plik fe'l ham oladigan guruh otlari (**the team is / are**); **police** va **people**; va bitta miqdor sifatida qaraladigan pul, vaqt, masofa (**ten pounds is**). O'zbekchada «shim», «kiyim», «yangilik», «jamoa» — hammasi oddiy birlik, shuning uchun bu yerda xato ko'p bo'ladi.
Ikki qismli narsalar: trousers, scissors, glasses

Ikki qismdan (ikki pocha, ikki oyna, ikki tig') iborat narsalar inglizchada faqat ko'plikda: **trousers**, **jeans**, **shorts**, **pyjamas**, **tights**, **glasses**, **sunglasses**, **binoculars**, **scissors**, **headphones**. Fe'l — ko'plikda (**are**, **were**), olmosh — **them**. «a trouser», «a scissor» deyilmaydi: bittasini sanash uchun **a pair of** ishlatiladi va fe'l **pair** ga moslashadi: **A pair of** jeans **costs** ..., **two pairs of** trousers. Ot + ot birikmasida esa birinchi so'z birlikda: a trouser pocket (→ 80-dars).

rows: My trousers **are** too long. / **a pair of** trousers
Where **are** the scissors? / **a pair of** scissors

items.text: **These trousers are** too tight — have you got them in a bigger size?
items.translation: **Bu shim** juda tor — kattaroq o'lchamdagisi bormi?

items.text: I need **a pair of** sunglasses before we go to the beach.
items.translation: Plyajga borishimizdan oldin menga **bitta** quyosh ko'zoynagi kerak.

items.text: Where **are** the scissors? I can't find **them** anywhere.

blocks.text: Boshqa ko'plik otlar: clothes, goods, stairs

Ba'zi otlar faqat ko'plikda ishlatiladi yoki ko'plikda alohida ma'no oladi, fe'l esa doim ko'plikda: **clothes** (kiyim-kechak), **goods** (tovarlar), **belongings** (shaxsiy buyumlar), **stairs** (zinapoya), **outskirts** (shahar chekkasi), **surroundings** (atrof), **congratulations** (tabrik), **thanks**, **earnings** (daromad), **savings** (jamg'arma), **customs** (bojxona), **contents** (ichidagi narsalar), **premises** (bino va hududi), **headquarters** (bosh qarorgoh — birlik ham, ko'plik ham bo'ladi). O'zbekchada bularning ko'pi birlikda aytiladi: «zinapoya tik» — **the stairs are** steep.
-s bilan tugaydigan birlik otlar: news, maths, physics

**news** — `-s` bilan tugasa ham birlik va sanalmaydigan ot: The news **is** good («are» emas). Bitta xabar — **a piece of news** («a news» emas, → 70-dars). Fan nomlari ham birlik: **mathematics** (**maths**), **physics**, **economics**, **politics**, **statistics**, **linguistics**; sport turlari: **athletics**, **gymnastics**; ba'zi kasalliklar: **measles**, **diabetes**. Nozik farq: **politics** va **statistics** «fan» ma'nosida birlik, lekin «qarashlar» yoki «raqamlar» ma'nosida ko'plik: Statistics **is** a hard subject — The statistics **are** worrying.

Ba'zi otlarning birlik va ko'pligi bir xil — ikkalasi ham `-s` bilan tugaydi: **a series** — **two series**, **a species** — **many species**, **a means** of transport — different **means**, **a crossroads** — two **crossroads**. Shuningdek **aircraft**: one aircraft — ten aircraft. Fe'l ma'noga qarab tanlanadi: A new series **starts** tonight — Both series **were** filmed in Khiva.

items.text: **The news is** much better than we expected.
**Economics was** my favourite subject at school.
**This species** of tulip **grows** wild only in the mountains of Central Asia.
items.translation: **Lolaning bu turi** faqat Markaziy Osiyo tog'larida yovvoyi holda o'sadi.

blocks.text: Guruh otlari: the team is yoki the team are?

**team**, **family**, **government**, **staff**, **audience**, **company**, **committee**, **class**, **crowd**, **band**, **public** — odamlar guruhini bildiradi. Britaniya ingliz tilida ular bilan fe'l **birlikda** ham, **ko'plikda** ham keladi. Guruh **bir butun** sifatida qaralsa — birlik (**is**, **it**, **its**): The team **is** top of the league. Guruhdagi **odamlar** haqida, ularning harakati yoki his-tuyg'usi haqida gapirilsa — ko'plik (**are**, **they**, **their**): The team **are** celebrating in the changing room. Jamoa va kompaniya nomlari ham shunday: Chelsea **are** playing tonight. Muhimi — gap ichida izchil bo'ling: is → it, are → they. Amerika ingliz tilida odatda faqat birlik ishlatiladi.

rows: The government **are** arguing about the budget.

items.text: This season **our team is** top of the league.
**The team are** on the bus, and **they're** all singing.
**The staff are** very friendly in this hotel.

blocks.text: **the police** — doim ko'plik fe'li bilan: The police **are** looking for ..., **Have** the police arrived? Bitta xodim — **a police officer** (yoki a policeman / a policewoman), «a police» deyilmaydi. **people** — ham ko'plik: People **are** ...; bitta odam — **a person**; **persons** — faqat rasmiy matnda (Maximum eight persons). **peoples** — «xalqlar»: the peoples of Central Asia. **cattle** (qoramol) ham doim ko'plik: The cattle **are** in the field. **staff** odatda ko'plik bilan keladi, bitta xodim — **a member of staff**.

Ko'plikdagi son + ot bitta **miqdor** (summa, muddat, masofa, og'irlik) sifatida qaralsa, fe'l **birlikda** keladi: **Ten thousand dollars is** a lot of money. **Three years is** a long time. **Five kilometres is** too far to walk. Bu yerda biz alohida dollar yoki yillarni emas, bitta umumiy miqdorni nazarda tutamiz. Vaqtning o'tishi haqida esa ko'plik ham tabiiy: **Ten years have passed** since we left school.

items.text: **Two hundred dollars is** too much for a pair of trainers.
items.translation: **Ikki yuz dollar** bir juft krossovka uchun juda ko'p.

items.text: **Three weeks isn't** long enough to see the whole country.
items.translation: Butun mamlakatni ko'rish uchun **uch hafta** yetarli emas.

items.text: **Ten kilometres is** a long way to walk in this heat.
items.translation: Bu jaziramada **o'n kilometr** piyoda yurish uchun uzoq yo'l.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «The news are good» → **The news is good**; «a news» → **a piece of news** / **some news**; «my trouser is dirty» → **my trousers are dirty**; «a police came» → **a police officer came**; «The police is coming» → **The police are coming**; «Maths are difficult» → **Maths is difficult**; «The stairs is» → **The stairs are**; «a clothes» → **some clothes** / **a piece of clothing**; «Three years are a long time» → **Three years is a long time**; «The team is ... and they ...» → izchil bo'ling: **The team are ... they** yoki **The team is ... it**.

Uch savol bering. 1) Narsa **ikki qismdanmi** (shim, qaychi, ko'zoynak)? — ko'plik, sanashda **a pair of**. 2) Bu **fan, sport yoki news**mi? — `-s` ga qaramang, birlik. 3) Bu **guruh**mi? — bir butun haqida **is**, odamlari haqida **are**; **police** esa doim **are**.

rows: ten pounds, three years, five kilometres

examples.title: Two-part things: **trousers**, **scissors**, **a pair of**
examples.description: Ikki qismdan iborat narsalar doim ko'plikda: fe'l — are, olmosh — them. Sanashda — **a pair of**, fe'l esa pair ga moslashadi.

sentences.text: Your new **jeans look** great — where did you buy **them**?
sentences.translation: Yangi **jinsi shiming** zo'r ko'rinyapti — **uni** qayerdan olding?

sentences.text: I've bought **two pairs of** trousers for my new job at the bank.
sentences.translation: Bankdagi yangi ishim uchun **ikkita** shim sotib oldim.

sentences.text: **My glasses are** broken, so I can't read the small print in this contract.
sentences.translation: **Ko'zoynagim** singan, shuning uchun shartnomadagi mayda yozuvni o'qiy olmayapman.

sentences.text: Are **these scissors** sharp enough to cut through cardboard?
sentences.translation: **Bu qaychi** kartonni kesishga yetarlicha o'tkirmi?

sentences.text: **A pair of** good walking boots **is** essential if you're going hiking in Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Chimyonda piyoda sayr qilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, **bir juft** yaxshi yurish botinkasi **shart**.

sentences.text: Kate's **pyjamas were** still wet, so she put **them** on the radiator.
sentences.translation: Keytning **pijamasi** hali ham ho'l edi, shuning uchun **uni** radiator ustiga yoyib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: The birdwatchers brought **binoculars** so that they could see the birds on the lake.
sentences.translation: Qushlarni kuzatuvchilar ko'ldagi qushlarni ko'rish uchun **durbin** olib kelishdi.

sentences.text: These **headphones are** so comfortable that I forget I'm wearing **them**.
sentences.translation: Bu **quloqchinlar** shunchalik qulayki, **ularni** taqib olganimni ham unutaman.

sentences.text: How much **are those shorts**? — They're on sale for fifteen pounds.
sentences.translation: **Anavi shortik** qancha turadi? — Chegirmada, o'n besh funt.

sentences.text: Bekzod can't find **his sunglasses**, although **they're** on top of his head!
sentences.translation: Bekzod **quyosh ko'zoynagini** topa olmayapti, holbuki **u** boshining ustida turibdi!

examples.title: Other plural nouns: **clothes**, **goods**, **stairs**
examples.description: Faqat ko'plikda ishlatiladigan yoki ko'plikda alohida ma'noli otlar: clothes, goods, stairs, belongings, outskirts, congratulations, savings, customs — fe'l ko'plikda.

sentences.text: All my **clothes are** in the washing machine, so I've got nothing to wear.
sentences.translation: Hamma **kiyimlarim** kir yuvish mashinasida, kiyishga hech narsam yo'q.

sentences.text: The **goods were** damaged during delivery, so we sent them back.
sentences.translation: **Tovarlar** yetkazib berish paytida shikastlangan edi, shuning uchun ularni qaytarib yubordik.

sentences.text: Be careful — **the stairs are** very steep in this old building.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling — bu eski binoda **zinapoya** juda tik.

sentences.text: Passengers must keep their **belongings** with them at all times.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar **shaxsiy buyumlarini** doim yonida saqlashi shart.

sentences.text: We live on **the outskirts** of Tashkent, where rents are much lower.
sentences.translation: Biz Toshkentning **chekkasida** yashaymiz, u yerda ijara ancha arzon.

sentences.text: **Congratulations** on your new job — you really deserve it!
sentences.translation: Yangi ishingiz bilan **tabriklayman** — bunga chindan loyiqsiz!

sentences.text: Most of their **savings were** spent on their daughter's wedding.
sentences.translation: Ularning **jamg'armalarining** katta qismi qizining to'yiga sarflandi.

sentences.text: It took us an hour to get through **customs** at the airport.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda **bojxonadan** o'tishimizga bir soat ketdi.

sentences.text: The company's **headquarters are** in London, but most of the staff work in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyaning **bosh ofisi** Londonda, lekin xodimlarining ko'pi Toshkentda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the **premises**, including the car park.
sentences.translation: **Bino va uning hududida**, jumladan avtoturargohda ham chekish taqiqlangan.

examples.title: Singular with -s: **news**, **maths**, **economics**
examples.description: -s bilan tugasa ham birlik: news, fan nomlari (maths, physics, economics, politics), sport turlari (athletics) va ba'zi kasalliklar (diabetes) — fe'l birlikda.

sentences.text: **The news is** on at nine, so let's eat before it starts.
sentences.translation: **Yangiliklar** soat to'qqizda boshlanadi, undan oldin ovqatlanib olaylik.

sentences.text: **Maths was** never my strong point, but I passed the exam in the end.
sentences.translation: **Matematika** hech qachon kuchli tomonim bo'lmagan, lekin oxiri imtihondan o'tdim.

sentences.text: **Physics is** harder than chemistry for most students at our school.
sentences.translation: Maktabimizdagi ko'p o'quvchilar uchun **fizika** kimyodan qiyinroq.

sentences.text: Jasur studied **economics** in London and now works for a bank in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Jasur Londonda **iqtisodiyot** bo'yicha o'qigan, hozir Toshkentdagi bankda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Is there any **news** from Dilnoza? — Yes, and **it's** good: she's got the job!
sentences.translation: Dilnozadan biror **yangilik** bormi? — Ha, **yaxshi** xabar: ishga qabul qilindi!

sentences.text: **Politics doesn't** interest me much, although my father watches every debate.
sentences.translation: **Siyosat** meni unchalik qiziqtirmaydi, garchi otam har bir bahsni ko'rsa ham.

sentences.text: **Athletics has** always been Kate's passion, and she runs every morning.
sentences.translation: **Yengil atletika** doim Keytning ishqibozligi bo'lgan, u har tong yuguradi.

sentences.text: **Diabetes is** becoming more common because people eat too much sugar.
sentences.translation: Odamlar haddan tashqari ko'p shakar iste'mol qilgani uchun **qandli diabet** tobora ko'payib bormoqda.

sentences.text: That's a really interesting **piece of news** — where did you hear it?
sentences.translation: Bu juda qiziq **yangilik** — qayerdan eshitdingiz?

sentences.text: **Statistics is** a compulsory subject, but **the statistics** in this report **are** out of date.
sentences.translation: **Statistika** majburiy fan, lekin bu hisobotdagi **statistik ma'lumotlar** eskirgan.

examples.title: Same form: **a series**, **a species**, **a means**
examples.description: Birlik va ko'plikda bir xil shakl: series, species, means, crossroads, aircraft. Fe'l ma'noga qarab: a series is / two series are.

sentences.text: **A new TV series** about the Silk Road **starts** next Monday.
sentences.translation: Ipak yo'li haqidagi **yangi teleserial** kelasi dushanba **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: Both **series were** filmed in Uzbekistan, in Khiva and Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Ikkala **serial** ham O'zbekistonda, Xiva va Buxoroda suratga olingan.

sentences.text: Scientists have discovered **a new species** of lizard in the Kyzylkum.
sentences.translation: Olimlar Qizilqumda kaltakesakning **yangi turini** kashf etishdi.

sentences.text: Many **species** of birds **are** disappearing because their habitats are being destroyed.
sentences.translation: Yashash joylari vayron qilinayotgani sababli qushlarning ko'plab **turlari** yo'qolib bormoqda.

sentences.text: For many people in the villages, a bicycle is still **the main means** of transport.
sentences.translation: Qishloqlardagi ko'p odamlar uchun velosiped hali ham **asosiy transport vositasi**.

sentences.text: We tried **every means** of contacting him — phone, email, even a letter.
sentences.translation: U bilan bog'lanishning **barcha yo'llarini** sinab ko'rdik — telefon, elektron pochta, hatto xat ham.

sentences.text: Turn right at **the next crossroads** and the hospital is on your left.
sentences.translation: **Keyingi chorrahada** o'ngga buriling, kasalxona chap tomonda.

sentences.text: **This aircraft** can carry three hundred passengers, and the airline has bought ten **aircraft** like it.
sentences.translation: **Bu samolyot** uch yuz yo'lovchini ko'tara oladi, aviakompaniya shunga o'xshash o'nta **samolyot** sotib oldi.

sentences.text: Is **a crossroads** with traffic lights safer than a roundabout?
sentences.translation: Svetoforli **chorraha** aylanma yo'ldan xavfsizroqmi?

sentences.text: The first **series was** a huge success, so the producers decided to make two more.
sentences.translation: Birinchi **mavsum** katta muvaffaqiyat qozondi, shuning uchun prodyuserlar yana ikkitasini suratga olishga qaror qilishdi.

examples.title: Group nouns: **the team is** / **the team are**
examples.description: team, family, government, staff, audience kabi guruh otlari: bir butun sifatida — birlik (is / it), a'zolari haqida — ko'plik (are / they). Britaniya ingliz tilida ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

sentences.text: **Our team is** top of the league, and **it** hasn't lost a game since March.
sentences.translation: **Jamoamiz** liga peshqadami, **u** martdan beri birorta o'yinda yutqazmagan.

sentences.text: Tonight **the team are** having a party to celebrate **their** victory.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **jamoa a'zolari** g'alabalarini nishonlash uchun ziyofat qilishyapti.

sentences.text: **My family is** quite small: just my parents, my brother and me.
sentences.translation: **Oilamiz** ancha kichik: faqat ota-onam, akam va men.

sentences.text: For Grandma's eightieth birthday **the whole family are** coming to Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Buvimning sakson yoshli tavalludi uchun **butun oila** Samarqandga **kelishyapti**.

sentences.text: **The government has** decided to raise the minimum wage from next January.
sentences.translation: **Hukumat** kelasi yanvardan eng kam ish haqini oshirishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: **The audience were** laughing so loudly that the actors had to stop for a moment.
sentences.translation: **Tomoshabinlar** shunchalik baland kulishdiki, aktyorlar bir zum to'xtashga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Apparently **the staff are** unhappy about the new working hours and want to see the director.
sentences.translation: Aytishlaricha, **xodimlar** yangi ish vaqtidan norozi va direktor bilan uchrashmoqchi.

sentences.text: **Chelsea are** playing at home on Saturday, so the tickets have sold out.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni **Chelsi** uyda o'ynaydi, shuning uchun chiptalar sotilib ketdi.

sentences.text: Is **the committee** going to make **its** decision before the end of the month?
sentences.translation: **Qo'mita** **o'z** qarorini oy oxirigacha chiqaradimi?

sentences.text: After a long world tour, **the band have** decided to take a year off.
sentences.translation: Uzoq jahon gastrolidan keyin **guruh a'zolari** bir yil dam olishga qaror qilishdi.

examples.title: Always plural: **the police**, **people**, **cattle**
examples.description: police, people, cattle doim ko'plik fe'li bilan. Bitta kishi — **a police officer**, **a person**; **peoples** — «xalqlar».

sentences.text: **The police are** looking for a man who stole a car outside the bank.
sentences.translation: **Politsiya** bank oldidan mashina o'g'irlagan odamni **qidiryapti**.

sentences.text: **A police officer** stopped Aziz because he was driving too fast.
sentences.translation: Aziz juda tez haydagani uchun uni **politsiyachi** to'xtatdi.

sentences.text: **Have the police** found out who broke into your flat?
sentences.translation: Kvartirangizga kim o'g'rilikka kirganini **politsiya aniqladimi**?

sentences.text: **People are** more relaxed in the summer, when the days are longer.
sentences.translation: Kunlar uzun bo'ladigan yozda **odamlar** xotirjamroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Only one **person was** injured in the accident, and he's already out of hospital.
sentences.translation: Avariyada faqat bir **kishi** jarohatlandi, u allaqachon kasalxonadan chiqdi.

sentences.text: This lift can carry a maximum of eight **persons**.
sentences.translation: Bu lift ko'pi bilan sakkiz **kishini** ko'tara oladi.

sentences.text: The **cattle are** kept indoors during the coldest months of the winter.
sentences.translation: Qishning eng sovuq oylarida **qoramol** ichkarida saqlanadi.

sentences.text: The museum tells the story of **the peoples** of Central Asia: Uzbeks, Kazakhs, Tajiks and many others.
sentences.translation: Muzey Markaziy Osiyo **xalqlari** — o'zbeklar, qozoqlar, tojiklar va boshqalar tarixini hikoya qiladi.

sentences.text: Why **were** so many **police** outside the stadium last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun stadion oldida nega shuncha ko'p **politsiyachi** bor edi?

sentences.text: **A member of staff** will show you to your room, sir.
sentences.translation: **Xodimlarimizdan biri** sizni xonangizga kuzatib qo'yadi, janob.

examples.title: One amount: **Fifty pounds is** too much
examples.description: Pul, vaqt, masofa va og'irlik bitta miqdor sifatida qaralsa — fe'l birlikda. Vaqtning o'tishi haqida ko'plik ham mumkin: ten years have passed.

sentences.text: **Fifty pounds is** too much for a ticket to a football match.
sentences.translation: Futbol o'yiniga chipta uchun **ellik funt** juda ko'p.

sentences.text: **Three years is** a long time to be away from your family.
sentences.translation: Oiladan **uch yil** uzoqda bo'lish — uzoq muddat.

sentences.text: Is **ten minutes** enough to get from the hotel to the station?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadan vokzalgacha yetib borishga **o'n daqiqa** yetadimi?

sentences.text: **Five kilometres isn't** far, so I usually walk to work.
sentences.translation: **Besh kilometr** uzoq emas, shuning uchun odatda ishga piyoda boraman.

sentences.text: I know **a thousand dollars sounds** like a lot, but the course is worth it.
sentences.translation: Bilaman, **ming dollar** ko'pga o'xshaydi, lekin kurs bunga arziydi.

sentences.text: **Two hours was** all we had to see the whole of the Registan.
sentences.translation: Butun Registonni ko'rish uchun bor-yo'g'i **ikki soatimiz** bor edi.

sentences.text: **Twenty kilos is** the maximum weight for checked luggage on this flight.
sentences.translation: Bu reysda topshiriladigan yuk uchun eng ko'p og'irlik — **yigirma kilogramm**.

sentences.text: Do you think **six months is** enough time to learn basic Korean?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, koreys tilining asoslarini o'rganish uchun **olti oy** yetarlimi?

sentences.text: **Ten years have passed** since we finished school, and a lot has changed.
sentences.translation: Maktabni bitirganimizga **o'n yil o'tdi**, ko'p narsa o'zgardi.

sentences.text: Although **forty degrees is** normal for Termez in July, this summer was too hot even for the locals.
sentences.translation: Iyulda Termiz uchun **qirq daraja** odatiy hol bo'lsa-da, bu yoz hatto mahalliy aholi uchun ham juda issiq bo'ldi.

examples.title: Mixed: news, work and everyday life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki qismli narsalar, -s li birlik otlar, guruh otlari, police va miqdorlar — bitta gapda bir nechtasi.

sentences.text: **The news** from the flooded villages **is** worrying, and **the police are** closing several roads.
sentences.translation: Suv bosgan qishloqlardan kelayotgan **yangiliklar** tashvishli, **politsiya** bir nechta yo'lni **yopyapti**.

sentences.text: My **jeans are** too long, so I'm taking **them** to a tailor near Chorsu.
sentences.translation: **Jinsi shimim** juda uzun, shuning uchun **uni** Chorsu yaqinidagi tikuvchiga olib boryapman.

sentences.text: **Mathematics is** Madina's favourite subject, and she wants to teach it one day.
sentences.translation: **Matematika** Madinaning eng sevimli fani, u bir kun kelib uni o'qitmoqchi.

sentences.text: **The staff were** given a bonus because **the company** had had its best year ever.
sentences.translation: **Kompaniya** eng yaxshi yilini o'tkazgani uchun **xodimlarga** mukofot puli berildi.

sentences.text: **A pair of** scissors **was** found in the passenger's hand luggage at security.
sentences.translation: Xavfsizlik nazoratida yo'lovchining qo'l yukidan **bitta qaychi** topildi.

sentences.text: Two **weeks is** not enough to see the Fergana Valley, Samarkand and Khiva.
sentences.translation: Farg'ona vodiysi, Samarqand va Xivani ko'rishga **ikki hafta** yetmaydi.

sentences.text: **People were** queuing outside the shop because **the goods were** half price.
sentences.translation: **Tovarlar** yarim narxda bo'lgani uchun **odamlar** do'kon oldida navbatda turishardi.

sentences.text: **Manchester United are** losing two-nil, and the fans **are** already leaving.
sentences.translation: **Manchester Yunayted** ikki-nol hisobida **yutqazyapti**, muxlislar esa allaqachon **ketishyapti**.

sentences.text: Where **are** my **headphones**? I left **them** on the desk with my **glasses**.
sentences.translation: **Quloqchinim** qayerda? **Uni** stol ustida **ko'zoynagim** bilan qoldirgan edim.

sentences.text: **The committee have** been arguing for hours, and **their** decision still isn't ready.
sentences.translation: **Qo'mita a'zolari** soatlab bahslashishyapti, **ularning** qarori hali ham tayyor emas.
